entry_state: The architecture places a shared typed representation between evidence and multiple authoring methods. AccDSL retains accounting, time, uncertainty and execution semantics; narrow adapters return typed results. The DSL remains a reversible authoring choice, and the next mathematical chapter must define the compatible histories and future outcomes carried by this architecture.
exit_state: The compatibility set is conditional on observation context, precision and model scope. Query answers must distinguish an entire family, individually certain rows and Boolean certainty; a liability of 100 can be certain while its creditor is not. The next derivation has begun showing why aggregation leaves historical movements unidentified, with its interpretation continuing on the next page.
findings: Equation 6.1 defines compatibility after its source contexts, model scope and rounding assumptions. Empty and singleton sets receive appropriately limited interpretations.
The two-creditor example distinguishes a certain total of 100 from an empty intersection of certain rows and a union incorrectly read as 200.
The Libkin discussion preserves information-order, genericity, representation and input/output-world assumptions. An inconclusive three-valued answer does not demonstrate opposing possible histories.
The aggregation nullspace display begins at the bottom of page 86; its interpretation and section judgment are deferred until the continuation is recorded. No confirmed defect in pages 84–86.
